title: CUMCM paper learning rubric

source_basis.name: 全国大学生数学建模竞赛章程
全国大学生数学建模竞赛全国奖项评阅工作规范（2023年修订稿）
全国大学生数学建模竞赛论文格式规范（2026年修订稿）
全国大学生数学建模竞赛人工智能工具使用规定（2026年试行）

scoring_note: The four equal weights below are an operational learning rubric, not an official prize cutoff or judging formula. Format and AI-policy compliance are reported separately as statuses and never add to or subtract from the 0-100 quality score.

policy_compliance.note: A quality score cannot prove compliance, and a compliance status is not a prize prediction.

dimensions.label: 基本假设的合理性
look_for: assumptions are explicit, minimal and tied to the problem context
scope, units, boundary conditions and data limitations are stated
sensitivity or failure conditions are acknowledged

dimensions.label: 建模的创造性
look_for: model structure matches the mechanism rather than blindly applying a named method
variables, constraints and objective are novel or well adapted
alternatives, ablations or robustness checks support the modeling choice

dimensions.label: 结果的正确性
look_for: data cleaning, validation, error analysis and units are consistent
conclusions answer every sub-question and do not overclaim

dimensions.label: 文字表述的清晰性
look_for: abstract, notation, figures and section structure are easy to follow
important claims are supported by equations, tables or references
the paper is concise, self-contained and distinguishes fact from inference

format_checks.note: These observations are retained for backward-compatible writing feedback. The official 2026 format decision must use the separate policy status and must not be inferred from this learning score.
items: problem restatement and assumptions are present
symbols and units are defined before use
figures/tables have captions and are referenced in text
references and appendices make computation reproducible
page/format constraints should be checked against the current year's notice

integrity_gates: missing evidence for a high score
data leakage or copied wording without attribution
conclusions that cannot be reproduced from the described method

interpretation.90-100: strong learning exemplar; still requires human review
